headline: Winter Wonderland progress, the 2026 annual parks report to the city council, and winter maintenance plans.
summary: The meeting will cover the annual parks report to the city council and Winter Wonderland progress. It will also cover winter maintenance plans and updates on parks, facilities, and recreation programs.

plain_text:
CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
PARKS COMMISSION 
SLATER MEMORIAL PARK 
PAWTUCKET, RHODE ISLAND 02861 
 
 
Dave Farrell 
CHAIRPERSON 
 
 
There will be a meeting of the: 
Pawtucket Parks Commission on Tuesday, November 10th 2026 
at 7:00 p.m. at Slater Park Pavilion, Pawtucket, RI 02861 
 
This meeting is being called by Dave Farrell, Chairperson of the Parks Commission. 
 
The purpose of the meeting is as follows: 
 
1.)  ROLL CALL 
 
2.)  PUBLIC INPUT 
    Visitors requesting to participate during the public input portion are required to sign in by 6:45 pm. 
 
3.)  APPROVE AND ACCEPT MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETING 
 
4.) CHAIRMANS' UPDATE 
 
5.)  REVIEW OLD BUSINESS 
    Annual Parks report to the city council. Next steps for end of year report/ possible added meeting 
 Food drive progress 
 
6.)  NEW BUSINESS 
    Introduction of New Parks Commission Member Ann Marie Braganca  
    Members individual wish lists citywide parks improvements for 2026 annual report 
    Winter Wonderland Progress/ Updates/ Questions 
 
7.)  PARKS & RECREATION UPDATE 
    Current status of parks and facilities 
    Current status of recreational programs and events 
    Winter Maintenance plans 
 
7.) OPEN FORUM 
 
8.) MOTION TO ADJOURN 
 
The agendas and past monthly meeting minutes are available at the Slater Park office one week before the meeting date 
noted above. For further information, call the City of Pawtucket Recreation Office at 728-0500 x251. 
 
*Posted 11/3/2026
